whatChanged: NEW: Samsung Electronics is reportedly in talks to acquire data-center cooling maker Modine, whose shares jumped ~29% on the Bloomberg report (mod-samsung-acquisition)
NEW: The FTC and a group of states sued to block Cencora's $3.5bn sale of MWI Animal Health to Covetrus (cor-covetrus-mwi-divestiture)

themes.label: Public-to-private buyout offers on listed companies
themes.note: Sponsors, strategics and insiders keep trying to take listed businesses off public markets, and targets are pushing back on price. CVC and GBL have reportedly crossed 90% of Recordati, clearing the way to a squeeze-out and delisting (rec-cvc-gbl-take-private). HealthSpan raised its Surgery Partners price to $25 after a rival $28 approach (sgry-bon-secours-take-private). Silver Lake and PIF are in preliminary talks to take Unity private at about $25bn (u-silver-lake-pif-take-private), and LS Power has proposed a $2.00-a-share buyout of EVgo's public float (evgo-ls-power-take-private). Wendy's rejected Trian's $7.35 bid and adopted a poison pill (wen-trian-take-private), Helen of Troy rejected Empower Brands' $37 proposal (hele-empower-takeover-proposal), LCI rejected Monomoy's $101 approach (lcii-monomoy-takeover-proposal), and Challenger rejected TAL Daiichi Life's A$11.80 bid (cgf-tal-daiichi-takeover-proposal). AVID has matched Warburg Pincus again at A$5.55 for Ingenia (ina-avid-takeover-proposal). Signed deals keep moving: Tata controls ~89% of Iveco (ivg-tata-motors-takeover-offer), Thrive Holdings is buying ADT with a go-shop to 28 November (adt-thrive-take-private), and Affle is delisting Perion (peri-affle-acquisition).

themes.label: Signed M&A deals hitting regulatory or legal roadblocks
themes.note: Regulators and supervisors, not the parties, keep setting deal timelines. Consob has cleared Intesa's Monte dei Paschi offer document after ECB authorisation, leaving Italy's antitrust authority as the remaining gatekeeper (isp-bmps-takeover-offer). DoorDash's $17bn Instacart deal is expected to draw an in-depth US antitrust probe, with closing not before late 2027 (cart-doordash-uber-acquisition), Marvell's $115bn Lumentum deal is not expected to close until 2028 (mrvl-lumentum-acquisition), and Mitsui Chemicals' $11.6bn JSR purchase needs Japanese and foreign competition and investment approvals, with closing not before late fiscal 2027 (4183-jsr-acquisition). Western Union terminated its Intermex purchase after California's financial regulator imposed conditions it would not accept, with Intermex disputing the termination (wu-intermex-acquisition). Surgery Partners' board picked HealthSpan's lower $25 bid over a $28 rival largely on the rival's regulatory complexity (sgry-bon-secours-take-private). JD.com could only close its Ceconomy takeover after EU merger-control, foreign-investment and foreign-subsidies clearances (jd-ceconomy-acquisition), and Hancock Whitney's Trustmark deal is timed around bank-regulator approval, targeting late Q1 2027 (hwc-trustmark-acquisition). The FTC and states have now sued in New York federal court to block Cencora's $3.5bn sale of MWI Animal Health to Covetrus, putting that divestiture in a judge's hands (cor-covetrus-mwi-divestiture).

themes.label: Large-caps scaling up buybacks and special payouts on surplus cash
themes.note: Companies with surplus capital keep expanding buybacks and payouts. Costco declared a $30-a-share (~$13.3bn) special dividend alongside a new $4bn repurchase programme (cost-special-dividend-2026), Lam Research authorized a new open-ended $25bn programme, far above the ~$3.9bn it repurchased in fiscal 2026 (lrcx-buyback-2026), and Simpson Manufacturing replaced a $200m authorization with $1.0bn (ssd-buyback-2026).

themes.label: European incumbents consolidating domestic rivals for scale
themes.note: Europe's large chemicals groups, banks and grocers are buying rivals to reach the scale of US and Chinese peers, while controlling shareholders, governments and supervisors decide the outcomes. Crédit Agricole has proposed merging its Italian arm into Banco BPM to create Italy's third-largest bank (bami-credit-agricole-merger), and Intesa Sanpaolo's Monte dei Paschi offer opens on 24 November (isp-bmps-takeover-offer). Evonik's board has refused to negotiate over BASF's €24-a-share approach, so RAG-Stiftung's ~43% stake is the decisive lever (evk-basf-acquisition). Ahold Delhaize is buying Tesco's Czech and Slovak arm to make its Albert chain Czechia's market leader (ad-tesco-cz-sk-acquisition).

themes.label: North American energy companies buying scale in core assets
themes.note: Oil, gas, refining and fuels companies are paying up to deepen positions in assets they already know. EQT agreed an all-stock deal for Range Resources to consolidate Appalachian gas (eqt-range-resources-acquisition), Ovintiv is buying Logan Energy to add Montney acreage (ovv-logan-energy-acquisition), Strathcona is folding in fellow Waterous-controlled oil sands producer Greenfire (scr-greenfire-acquisition), CVR Energy is buying Marathon Petroleum's two Upper Midwest refineries for ~$4.2bn (cvi-mpc-refineries-acquisition), and The Andersons is paying $915m for Harvestone's three ethanol plants (ande-harvestone-acquisition).
